$values.Text: Prepares the equipment. Set the cooling temperature for your camera; connect the equipment before you start the sequence.

Requires the NSTN plugin 0.9.0 or later and the SQM value of your site in Options > Plugins > NSTN. Set your target here (name search, Framing or Sky Atlas). The filter names in the NSTN filter plan must match the filter wheel list of your profile: pick yours in each row. NSTN Night Info shows the night and checks the setup.

Autofocus once here, then every hour (trigger 'AF After Time', 60 min). For it to focus on L, two settings of the profile: tick 'Autofocus filter' for L in the filter list (Options > Equipment > Filterwheel) and switch on 'Use filterwheel offsets' (Options > Equipment > Focuser). N.I.N.A. then changes to L for the autofocus and back afterwards; the NSTN filter plan goes on with its own filter. Enter the focus offsets of the other filters relative to L.
Runs once the filter plan has ended: no NSTN window opens again this night.
